Interactive design test • not the game

Digimon: left & right facing

Try walking left and right. The same animated Digimon sprite is mirrored horizontally to face the direction it is moving. Toggle mirroring off to compare the previous fixed-view test.

This is a proposed style, not the current Social Hub. The background is a simple mock-up; it is not the actual in-game plaza. The adventurer is an existing reference sprite. No gameplay or save is changed.

Facing:A horizontal flip; this does not create a real back view.

Tip: choose “Auto compare” to watch the Digimon walk both ways. The attack plays once, then returns to idle. Sample sizes are normalized around Patamon; evolution size choices are still open.

How mirroring works

Walking left ←The same artwork is flipped horizontally to face left.
Walking right →The original artwork faces right.
Decision after trying it: Does the mirrored movement look good, and are these sample sizes closer to what you want? This is still only left/right facing; the sprites have no real front/back views.
About these samples

Actual PNG frames from dannyphang/digimon-up-sprites, commit 4eaee71. These four samples have idle, walking, attack and faint sequences at 62.5 ms per frame. The full source contains 280 animated entries, including alternate versions; this demo includes only four. The sample adventurer is from the repository's class-sprite reference. The actual Sanctuary, training and PvP are not implemented.
